# After Babel

> > After Babel investigates how smartphones and social media are reshaping childhood, mental health, and community in America through research-backed analysis and policy advocacy.

After Babel is a research and advocacy platform founded by social psychologist Jon Haidt that examines the impact of digital technology on young people's development, mental health, and social connection. The site combines peer-reviewed research, expert commentary, and practical guidance to inform parents, educators, and policymakers about phone-based childhood and its alternatives.

## Key Topics

- smartphone impact on youth
- social media regulation
- child mental health
- phone-free schools
- play-based childhood
- community decline
- teen safety online
- parental guidance
- digital wellness
- school policy
- KOSA legislation
- screen time effects
- child development
- neighborhood restoration
- Gen Z mental health

## Research & Analysis

- [The Fundamental Flaws of The Only Meta-Analysis of Social Media Reduction Experiments (And Why It Matters), Part 1](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/the-case-for-causality-part-1): Critique of meta-analysis on social media reduction experiments and mental health
- [The Achievement Gap We're Not Talking About](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/silent-achievement-gap): Analysis of widening achievement gap in student performance since 2015
- [Scrolling Alone - by Andrew Trousdale and Erik J Larson](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/scrolling-alone): History of convenience-connection tradeoffs in America and digital age impact
- [The Insidious Lie That We Can't Understand Each Other](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/identity-trap): Yascha Mounk on identity politics and social polarization in modern society

## Schools & Education

- [Should Schools Ban Phones? - by Jacqueline Nesi, PhD](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/should-schools-ban-phones): Evidence evaluation on phone-free schools and student mental health by researcher
- [The False Promise of Device-Based Education](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/false-promise-of-device-based-ed): Reevaluation of screens in schools and educational technology effectiveness

## Child Safety & Online Harms

- [Growing up Online Nearly Killed Me](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/growing-up-online-nearly-killed-me): Mother-daughter narrative on online grooming, sextortion, and digital safety
- [Don't Give Your Child Any AI Companions](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/dont-give-your-child-an-ai-companion): Warnings on AI companion dangers for child safety and mental health
- [How To Reduce the Sexual Solicitation of Teens on Instagram](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/make-social-media-safe-for-teens): Meta whistleblower Arturo Béjar's suggestions for reducing teen sexual solicitation
- [How Tech Companies Rig Parental Guilt](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/how-tech-companies-rig-parental-guilt): Tech platform manipulation of parental guilt and children's attention exploitation

## Policy & Regulation

- [Congress Must Pass KOSA By Christmas. The Only Obstacle Seems to be Meta's Influence](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/congress-must-pass-kosa-by-christmas): Advocacy for KOSA legislation passage and Meta's lobbying influence
- [Big News: KOSA is Being Marked Up Today While Meta Tries to Show (Too Late) That It Can Self-Regulate](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/kosa-mark-up): KOSA legislation markup and Meta's self-regulation response in child safety policy
- [The UK Is Doing the Hard Work of Protecting Children Online](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/the-uk-is-doing-the-hard-work-of): Beeban Kidron on UK online safety regulation and age-appropriate design code

## Community & Childhood Development

- [Neighborhoods that Nurture: Why The Play-Based Childhood Requires More Than Just Putting Down the Phone](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/neighborhoods-that-nurture-why-the): Seth Kaplan on community-based childhoods and neighborhood decline solutions
- [The Real User Interface: Recovering Our Neighborhoods](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/the-real-user-interface-recovering): Seth Kaplan on neighborhood restoration and community-based childhood development
- [Let Kids Be Loud - by Katherine Martinko - After Babel](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/let-kids-be-loud): Defense of outdoor play and children's noise in urban neighborhoods

## Practical Guidance & Impact

- [It's Never Too Late to Turn Things Around - by Andrea Davis](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/family-tech-reset): Practical guide for family tech reset after early smartphone and social media use
- [A Year of Real Progress for Kids](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/a-year-of-real-progress-for-kids): After Babel movement highlights, research findings, and annual progress review
- [It Was the Damn Phones - by Korijanes - After Babel](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/it-was-the-damn-phones): Gen Z poetry on smartphone impacts and phone-based childhood effects

## Optional

- [Do You Want To Help Us With Research?](https://www.afterbabel.com/p/join-us): Research recruitment for social science researchers at After Babel
